Run and complete a departure report after corroboration.
Return an updated copy of the departure report to Front Desk.

items.title: Select the vacant rooms that require stripping and cleaning:
items.title_es: Seleccione las habitaciones vacías que requieren deshacer y limpiar

items.title: Open
detail: Clocked in, in uniform, radio and earpiece on and working properly.
Checking in with all Room Attendants and reviewing their boards for the day.
Continuously checking Room Attendant bags, removing trash, retrieving linen, and stocking commonly-needed amenities.
Ready to deliver guest requests to their rooms within 15 minutes.
Assisting with any special projects assigned by supervisor

items.title: Closet
detail: Informing leadership of closet items running low so they can be restocked.

items.title: Linen & Laundry
detail: Restocking linen and laundry whenever levels run low.

items.title: Public Areas
detail: Guest corridors, stairs, and stairwells clean and swept

items.title: Trash
detail: All trash disposed of in the designated area by end of shift.

items.title: Room Attendant Bags
detail: All Room Attendant bags emptied and restock any cleaning products for the next shift.

items.title: BED
detail: No rips or tears in linen, not wrinkled, in clean condition. Baby Grand hotel logo facing the upright direction.

items.title: BATHROOM
detail: Clean, no hair or dust; new, clean, fresh terry; all amenities clean and filled to an appropriate level; everything in working order.

items.title: FLOORS
detail: No scuffs or damage, no stains, properly swept/mopped and free of dust.

items.title: WINDOWS
detail: No visible fingerprints, window clean and clear, opens and closes properly.

items.title: CURTAINS
detail: No stains or rips visible; check behind and underneath for anything a guest may have left behind.

items.title: TV
detail: Clear of fingerprints and dust, in working order.

items.title: MIRROR
detail: Clear of fingerprints and dust.

items.title: MINI BAR
detail: Clean and stocked; mini-bar attendant notified if not stocked; nothing used or opened in the refrigerator.

items.title: MINI FRIDGE
detail: Clean and stocked; mini-bar attendant notified if not stocked; nothing used or opened in the refrigerator.

items.title: EVIDENCE OF PREVIOUS HUMANS
detail: Room feels as though no guest has ever resided in it before; check all areas for anything a guest may have left or hidden.

items.title: Room List
detail: Get the vacant or dirty room list from supervisors.
Update throughout the day.

items.title: Closets
detail: Ensure all closets are properly restocked and clean.
Monitor throughout the day.

items.title: Rooms & Linens
detail: Strip vacant rooms as directed by Housekeeping.
Take dirty linen to the laundry room.

items.title: Hallways & Rooms
detail: Keep all hallways and rooms swept, mopped, and presentable.

items.title: Stairways
detail: Check stairways to make sure they are clean and free of dust.

items.title: Trash
detail: Remove all trash from assigned floors and any storage areas.
Continuously remove trash from housekeeper carts.

items.title: Housekeeping Bags
detail: Remove all trash, dirty rags, and dirty linen.
Bring all to the laundry area

proof.prompt: All trash, dirty rags, and dirty linen

items.title: Hosekeeping Closets
detail: Maintain all housekeeping closets clean and organized

items.title: Restocking
detail: Restock closets, linen, and supplies.
Sign the inventory sheet.

items.title: Vacant Rooms
detail: Strip any vacant rooms.

items.title: Vacuums & Bags
detail: Clean vacuums.
Change bags as needed.

items.title: Stairs
detail: Sweep, mop, and dust the stairs.

items.title: Premises Check
detail: Walk the property.
Confirm all hallways, landscaping lights, and lamps are clean.

items.title: Requests & Projects
detail: Own and complete guest requests.
Complete any other project assigned by the supervisor.

items.title: Chandeliers
detail: Be sure they are clean and free of cobwebs
Lightbulbs all working, if not replace the lightbulb.

items.title: Hallways
detail: Sweep hallway floors.
Ensure marble baseboards through the corridors are clean and polished.

items.title: Floors
detail: Mop the floors in the public areas.

items.title: Preliminary Checks
detail: Clocked in, in uniform, earpiece and radio on and working properly.
Checked in with all outlets, namely Night Hawk, Fallen Empire, and Café Bar, with the person in charge of each.

items.title: Lobby Restrooms
detail: Lobby restrooms are clean and in good, presentable condition.

items.title: Hallways
detail: Public hallways are clean and free of trash and dust.

items.title: Trash Bins
detail: Replace liners when almost full.

items.title: Lagoon
detail: Lagoon area clean.
Towels are available at the lagoon upon guest request.

proof.prompt: Cleaned lagoon area and stocked towels

items.title: Front Driveway
detail: Front drive free of trash.
Check planters for cleanliness.

items.title: Wall Decor
detail: Pictures and mirrors are free of dust and fingerprints.

items.title: Floors
detail: Sweep the floors in the public areas.

items.title: Bathroom
detail: Toilet bowl, base and seat scrubbed, no residue.
Sink and counter wiped, no hair/dust.
Mirror fingerprint-free.
Shower walls and glass clean, no soap residue.
Drain hair-free.
Tub clean and drained, if applicable.
Floor swept and mopped, no mildew.
Fresh towels hung.
All amenities filled, including soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash.

proof.prompt: wide shot capturing toilet, sink and shower in one frame

items.title: Bedroom
detail: Bed made, linens no rips, tears, or wrinkles.
Logo facing upright direction.
Pillows and bedding restocked to par.
Carpet vacuumed.
Window shades left open for view.
Windows clean, with no fingerprints.
TV fingerprint and dust-free.
Mirrors fingerprint and dust-free.
Minibar and refrigerator clean, and nothing opened.
Patio and seating area cushions placed, patio swept, furniture wiped, if applicable.

proof.prompt: wide shot from doorway showing bed and room

items.title: Mini Bar Pre Check-In
detail: Mini bar confirmed: books, steamers, decanters, coffee.
Missing items logged and reordered, ticket auto-created.

proof.prompt: on Yes: mini bar setup pre-arrival

items.title: Is everything in good condition and functioning properly?
items.title_es: ¿Todo está en buen estado y funcionando correctamente?
detail: Bathroom fixtures.
No tears, rips, stains on curtains or carpets.
Windows opening and closing.
TV working.

items.title: Were any lost items found?
detail: Check behind curtains.

items.title: Mark the room marked clean in PMS.
items.title_es: Marcar la habitación como limpia en el PMS.
